label: PF Backlog 633
title: Design-token engine upgrade (3-tier OKLCH, light+dark)
body:
## Problem / why
core/design_tokens.py ships fixed M3 defaults; no 3-tier architecture, no OKLCH, no direction seeding.

## Goal & value
Generate real design tokens from the selected direction.

## In scope
- Go token engine go/pfcore/design_tokens.go (global->alias->component, OKLCH ramps, light+dark, from a DesignDirection).
- Edit core/design_tokens.py to consume it while staying the single writer of tokens.json/tokens.css.

## Out of scope
- Multi-brand theming beyond the selected direction (later).

## Definition of Done
- Contrast validated per theme.
- Existing token callers unaffected (regression test).

## Verification
Structured `acceptance_criteria` is the single source of truth for verification.
